description: This file defines the AssetValueAdjustment class for handling asset value adjustments, including validation, depreciation entry creation, and depreciation rescheduling within an ERP system.

classes.name: AssetValueAdjustment
classes.description: A Document class for managing asset value adjustments, including validation, depreciation journal entry creation, and depreciation rescheduling.

methods.name: validate
methods.description: Performs validation checks, including date validation and setting current asset value and difference amount.

methods.name: on_submit
methods.description: Handles actions to perform when the asset value adjustment is submitted, such as creating depreciation entries and rescheduling depreciations.

methods.name: on_cancel
methods.description: Handles actions to perform when the adjustment is canceled, such as rescheduling depreciations to previous values.

methods.name: validate_date
methods.description: Validates that the adjustment date is not before the asset's purchase date.

methods.name: set_difference_amount
methods.description: Calculates and sets the difference between current and new asset values.

methods.name: set_current_asset_value
methods.description: Retrieves and sets the current asset value if not already set.

methods.name: make_depreciation_entry
methods.description: Creates a depreciation journal entry reflecting the asset value adjustment.

methods.name: reschedule_depreciations
methods.description: Reschedules depreciation schedules based on the new asset value, considering country-specific depreciation methods.
